description:
Stock per listing (POST /stock-management/1/info): quantity,
    is_unlimited, is_out_of_stock. Up to 500 ids per call.

    Args:

    Returns JSON: {"ok": true, "data": {"stocks": [{"item_id", "quantity", ...}]}}.
name: avito_get_stocks
